title: Response filtering leaves the HTTP transport correct
description: Individual hardened packet derived from the 2026-09-03 holistic Kitty codebase review at base 70c15583a6afa4aac9a6f6eb11abf840afa377a4. It is intentionally separate from active ONE KITTY execution and is not applied by authoring this manifest.

packets.title: Response filtering leaves the HTTP transport correct
packets.objective: This packet creates no new files. Remove personality/voice cleanup from the global HTTP transport layer. First add a regression proving the stale Content-Length/body-reconstruction bug. Move `filter_response` to the smallest shared generation boundary that still covers the non-stream chat/completion path not already filtering explicitly; preserve existing filtering for `/ask`, voice, and Telegram without double-filtering. Remove `VoiceGateMiddleware` registration once every intended generation path is explicit. Streaming SSE responses must remain streaming and must not be buffered for filtering. Preserve status codes, cookies/background tasks, response headers, and non-LLM JSON byte-for-byte. If a common generation helper already provides the necessary boundary on current main, extend it rather than adding another middleware/helper.
acceptance_criteria: No global middleware buffers and reconstructs arbitrary JSON responses for voice/personality cleanup.
Non-stream generated assistant text is filtered exactly once at a generation boundary.
SSE/streaming completion responses remain streaming and are not collected into memory for filtering.
Non-LLM JSON responses preserve their original body, status, and headers.
A regression demonstrates that filtering cannot leave a stale Content-Length header.
Existing `/ask`, voice, and Telegram filtering behavior remains covered.
